FileSystemManager.exists(Object object)

Check whether a file or folder exists(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
path String Yes Path to be determined. (The local path can be a relative directory in the usr directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory. The temporary path and cache path files can be checked.)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

success callback function

Object res
Attribute Type Description
exist Boolean Exists or not
type String File type (file) or folder type (directory)

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();

fs.readdir({
  path: `path`,
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.exists);
    console.log(res.type);
  },
  fail(err){
    console.log(err);
  }
});
